Triplet: ["MAO inhibitors", "include", "tranylcypromine"]

In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:

B. 'affects': The condition specified by the object entity impacts a certain proportion or group of individuals specified by the subject entity.
C. 'belongs to drug class': The subject drug is a member of the pharmacological or therapeutic drug class specified by the object entity.
D. 'has location': The subject entity is located at the address specified by the object entity.
